title: BotCommand
description: bot.command@1: an operator's command frame on OpenVibe.Bot's operator WebSocket (wss://openvibe.bot/control, after join; server/realtime.js onOperatorCommand). id is the operator's idempotency key (at most 64 characters; Bot mints one when it is missing): a repeated id answers with the first result. Bot's gate stamps the robot, the operator and the role, builds the value from the robot profile's commands (clamped by the owner's limits) and sets the deadline; ms asks for a duration within max_command_ms. Answered by one command_result frame (bot.command-result@1). The kinds button (a profile button by name, with an optional state for a hold button) and point (a normalised x, y video click) were added in 0.109.0 (plan T15 R9). The computer kinds (exec, fs, screen, input, browser; OpenVibe.Node's computer plugin, Node docs/computer.md) are taken only for a person's own machine, from its owner or an agent the owner let use it (bot.computer.control); the machine's owner sets on the machine what they may do, and the answer comes back in bot.command-result@1's data. probe (a read-only check of something on the machine's own network) is the one computer kind OpenVibe.Watch may send, for owners who let their watches use the computer. input (added in 0.171.0) moves the mouse, clicks, scrolls, types or presses keys on the machine's screen, at coordinates in the space of the screen picture the caller last saw (its width and height; the Node scales them to the real screen): refused at level observe, approved one by one at ask. browser (added in 0.174.0) drives a Chromium-family browser the agent uses on the machine, in a profile of its own: open an http(s) URL, click a CSS selector or the button or link showing a text, fill a field, press a named key, go back, read the page, take a screenshot, or close it. read, screenshot and close run at every level; the rest act (refused at observe, approved one by one at ask), and below level full open refuses an address on the machine's own network. desk (added in 0.214.0; plan track K, Vibe's desk) starts, stops or reports a private desk on the machine: a display of its own (Xvfb, a window manager, its own session and browser profile) where an agent works without touching the person's screen, which the person can watch and take over; screen, input and browser take desk: private to act there instead of on the person's screen (main, the default). Starting and stopping a desk act (refused at observe, approved one by one at ask); status runs at every level.

state.description: present only for a hold button: down on press, up on release

argv.description: a program and its arguments, never a shell line

cwd.description: an absolute folder on the machine (default: its first allowed folder)

timeout_s.description: capped by the owner's timeout_s on the machine

desk.description: which session it runs in (Node v0.26.0): the person's own (main, the default), or a desk's (private or desk-<name>): the desk's display, session bus and temp folder, so a program with windows opens on that desk; start the desk first

detach.description: on a whole desk only (Node v0.26.0): start a program that keeps running (an office suite, a terminal, an editor) and answer at once with its pid; it runs until the desk stops. Never on the person's own session or a browser desk

content_b64.description: write: at most 256 KB of content, base64

mode.description: write: create (default) never replaces a file

desk.description: which display: the person's own screen (main, the default), the machine's first private desk (private) or a named desk (desk-<name>, Node v0.19.0: one per agent task); start the desk first

target.description: http(s)://host[:port]/path (one GET, no redirect followed) or tcp://host:port (does it accept a connection); on the machine's own network only: a private, loopback or link-local address

action.description: move, click, double_click and right_click take x and y; scroll takes dy (and x, y to scroll at a point); type takes text; key takes keys

width.description: the width of the picture x is measured in (the screen kind's answer); without it x is in screen pixels

height.description: the height of the picture y is measured in

dy.description: scroll clicks: negative scrolls up, positive down

text.description: typed as keystrokes into whatever has focus

keys.description: one key or chord, for example Return, Escape, ctrl+s, alt+Tab

desk.description: which display: the person's own screen (main, the default), the machine's first private desk (private) or a named desk (desk-<name>, Node v0.19.0: one per agent task); start the desk first

action.description: open takes url; click takes selector or text; fill takes selector and text; press takes key; screenshot may take max_width

text.description: click: the text a button or link shows (at most 200); fill: what to type

desk.description: which display: the person's own screen (main, the default), the machine's first private desk (private) or a named desk (desk-<name>, Node v0.19.0: one per agent task); start the desk first

action.description: start a desk (a no-op when it runs), stop it, report it, or list the desks that run (list, Node v0.19.0)

desk.description: which desk (Node v0.19.0): private (the default, the first desk) or desk-<name>; each desk has its own display, browser profile, downloads and temp folder, and a machine runs at most its max_desks at once

kind.description: start only (Node v0.23.0, Desks plan D2): what the desk is. desktop (the default) is a whole screen: a display, a window manager and a browser shown on it (Linux with Xvfb). browser is a browser alone with no display (Linux or macOS with Chromium), about half the cost: its screen, mouse and keyboard and its live view are the page's own. A machine says which it runs in its computer capabilities (desk.kinds)

profile.description: start only, a named desk (Node v0.24.0): a browser profile kept on the machine by that name. The desk's browser starts from it (its cookies and site storage: the person signs in once, on any desk) and the desk saves it back when it stops (the last desk to stop wins); caches are never kept. The private desk keeps its own profile. A machine that keeps profiles says so in its computer capabilities (desk.profiles)

width.description: start only: the desk's width in pixels (default 1280)

height.description: start only: the desk's height in pixels (default 800)
